description: The plot illustrates the similarity of HSAs in different languages across various layers within Qwen1.5-1.8B. The x-axis, labeled 'Layer', has a linear scale, ranging from 0 to 22 with a tick label interval of 2. The y-axis, labeled 'Similarity', also has a linear scale, ranging from 0.00 to 0.45 with a tick label interval of 0.05. Four lines are plotted: 'en&en' in red, solid line style, starts at 0.05 at layer 0, peaks at 0.27 at layer 6, and ends at 0.43 at layer 22; 'en&es' in blue, solid line style, starts at 0.04 at layer 0, peaks at 0.25 at layer 6, and ends at 0.37 at layer 22; 'en&el' in green, solid line style, starts at 0.03 at layer 0, peaks at 0.14 at layer 12, and ends at 0.29 at layer 22; 'en&bn' in purple, solid line style, starts at 0.02 at layer 0, peaks at 0.15 at layer 12, and ends at 0.32 at layer 22. All lines generally exhibit an initial increase, followed by a decline, and then a sharp rise at the final layer.
